subject: PO authorization gap for Nexus Freight onboarding
messages:
From: Sara Johns <sara.johns@nexusfreight.com>
To: jasmine_liu@redwoodinference.com
Cc: vendor-ops@nexusfreight.com
Date: 2026-09-07T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Nexus Freight vendor onboarding + PO request

Hi Jasmine,

Thanks for taking us through the portal yesterday. Attached are the completed vendor onboarding form and W-9. We are ready to be activated. Can you confirm the PO number issuance workflow and expected timeline? Our procurement policy requires an initial spend cap established for the first 90 days while we run integration tests.

A few specifics:
- We expect two invoice line items: "Integration & Testing" and "Monthly Platform Usage".
- Prefer to have the initial spend cap of $25,000 split 30% / 70% across the two line items.
- Our finance team uses VendorPay; Tom Ellis (cc'd on follow-ups) will handle payment onboarding.

Please let us know if the split is possible or if Redwood needs a different split or a provisional PO number.

Attachments: Nexus_Vendor_Onboarding_Form.pdf, Nexus_W9.pdf

Best,
Sara Johns
Procurement Manager, Nexus Freight
Sara.Johns@nexusfreight.com

From: jasmine_liu@redwoodinference.com
To: Sara Johns <sara.johns@nexusfreight.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com, mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-09-07T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Nexus Freight vendor onboarding + PO request

Hi Sara —

Thanks for the docs and clear breakdown. Quick checklist from our side:
- We can issue a provisional PO while KYC/finance completes. Provisional PO numbers (format PROV-56789) are common for initial onboarding.
- The spend cap split you requested (30% Integration & Testing / 70% Monthly Platform Usage) is feasible but we need explicit line-item mapping in CSV to attach to the PO. Can you confirm exact line descriptions and unit of measure (e.g., hours vs lump sum)?
- We require a signed vendor contract before we convert to a permanent PO. I see a redline from your legal team might be incoming — if you can share it, we can fast-track review.

Actions I propose:
1) Nexus to send a small CSV with the two line items + amounts (we can accept draft numbers).
2) Rishi (cc) to approve provisional PO if finance is OK with the requested cap.
3) Mina (cc) to coordinate contract redline intake and route to Legal.

If you prefer, we can set a 20-minute call tomorrow to finalize the split and provisional PO metadata.

-Jasmine Liu
Vendor Onboarding Specialist | Redwood Inference

From: rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com
To: jasmine_liu@redwoodinference.com
Cc: mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com, sara.johns@nexusfreight.com
Date: 2026-09-08T08:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Nexus Freight vendor onboarding + PO request

Jasmine / Mina / Sara —

Thanks for the details. Approving a provisional PO is fine under the following controls:
- Provisional PO number: PROV-56789 (will be created by Finance Ops today).
- Provisional spend cap: $25,000 for 90 days.
- Required: Nexus to provide the CSV with line items and the anticipated split. Once CSV received, Finance Ops will seed the PO lines as provisional amounts and tag the PO as "ONBOARDING-PROV".
- Contract: Legal must receive the vendor_contract_redline.pdf within 5 business days; otherwise the provisional PO will be reduced to $5k pending legal sign-off.

I asked Finance Ops to seed the provisional PO and to set an internal approval task assigned to me. Mina — please confirm receipt of the redline and escalate if there are material terms (data residency, audit logs, or SLAs) requiring leadership review.

Tom / Nexus — please loop VendorPay contact if any payment routing metadata is needed for VendorPay integration (we have a small field for external payment systems in PO metadata).

-Rishi Malhotra
Head of Procurement & Vendor Ops | Redwood Inference

From: vendor-ops@nexusfreight.com (Vendor Ops)
To: rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com, jasmine_liu@redwoodinference.com
Cc: tom.ellis@vendorpay.com, mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-09-09T15:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: PO PROV-56789 confirmed + line item CSV attached

Hi Rishi / Jasmine / Mina —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. Attached is the requested CSV (PO-56789_lineitems.csv) with the two line rows and the 30/70 split applied. We also attached our redlined contract (vendor_contract_redline.pdf) for your Legal team.

Confirming next steps on our side:
- Nexus accepts provisional PO number PROV-56789 and will proceed with integration testing against that cap.
- Tom Ellis (VendorPay) will share payment routing metadata via the DocuSign envelope linked here: https://www.docusign.net/envelope/SOME-UUID-HERE.
- We request Redwood to convert the provisional PO to a permanent PO once the contract is signed and KYC completes.

Appreciate the help — please advise if the seeded PO needs a line-item correction (description or UOM).

Best,
Sara Johns on behalf of Vendor Ops, Nexus Freight
[attachments referenced in thread: Nexus_Vendor_Onboarding_Form.pdf, Nexus_W9.pdf, PO-56789_lineitems.csv, vendor_contract_redline.pdf]
